title: OTA (tenant) status
caption: `platform.tenants.status`. Only `active` OTAs are served by the storefront, the OTA API and the console; `suspended` answers `403 TENANT_SUSPENDED` on the OTA side within 60 s (vx:invalidate tenant).

states.label: provisioning
states.detail: Rows written by `createTenant`; waiting for the `provision` job (and, from M5, for the Checkout).

states.label: active
states.detail: Served. Writes to keys, domains and connections need this status (`409 TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE` otherwise).

states.label: suspended
states.detail: `suspension_reason` billing, abuse, request or admin. Keys, domains and connections are read-only.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Provisioning gave up, or the Checkout was abandoned for 48 h. Does not count against MAX_TENANTS_PER_ACCOUNT.

states.label: deprovisioning (reserved)
states.detail: Allowed by the CHECK; no MVP code path sets it.

states.label: deleted (reserved)
states.detail: Allowed by the CHECK; no MVP code path sets it.

transitions.label: retryProvisioning (owner; 422 tenant_limit while an owner is at MAX_TENANTS_PER_ACCOUNT) / adminRetryProvisioningJob (exempt from the limit)
adminSuspendTenant / billing sync (canceled, unpaid, incomplete_expired) / billing.manual_trials
adminResumeTenant / billing sync when the subscription is trialing or active
